meta.title: Withdrawing Order...: Letters and mixed text are handled consistently in the reason

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ without creating or searching for another event.
Open the RFQ stage as required by the case.
Navigate to the RFQ Responses tab before opening Settings.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu and choose Withdraw to open the withdrawal window.

steps.note: Enter the mixed letters, numbers, spaces, and underscore in the withdrawal reason field.
